scope.purpose: Let the user enter or edit a short single-line text value (name, email, search query, password, URL, phone number).
useCases: A form field inside Field, with label, description and error message.
A standalone search box in a toolbar, named by its label prop, with a leading magnifying-glass icon.
A readonly value that can still be selected and copied (an identifier, an API key).
A search box with a clear button, or a password field with a show/hide button, as a trailing IconButton at sizes md and lg.
exclusions: Numbers with steppers (NumberInput), dates and times (DatePicker, TimeInput), suggestions (Combobox): their own components.
Prefix/suffix text (units, currency), character counters, input masks and formatting.
A trailing IconButton at size sm (too little room for a second target), and built-in clear or show-password logic: the application supplies the IconButton and its action.
alternatives: Combobox (wave 4) for a value chosen among suggestions.
DataField (wave 5) to display a value that cannot be edited at all.

fixtures: Phosphor glyphs re-exported by examples/icon/glyphs.ts for the leading/trailing icon examples.

decisionsTaken: One derived state axis `condition` keys the field and choice color families (color.field.{condition}.*, color.choice.{selection}.{condition}.*), resolved from the disabled, readonly and invalid props and pointer hover with a fixed precedence (disabled, readonly, invalid, [focus,] hover, default). The props stay separate (contract-guide: validation is not an interaction state); only the token lookup is flattened, as the approved field family already is.

A standalone text entry or radio group takes its accessible name from an optional, non-displayed label prop (the IconButton precedent); inside a Field the Field label wins. There is no visually hidden Field label: a control without a visible label is used without Field.
Controls perform no validation and expose invalid/required only; the visible error message and required marker belong to Field (catalog composition rule: controls are standalone, Field wraps them).

Same horizontal spacing as Button (edge-inline, label-inline, slot-inline, optical icon placement), so an InputText and a Button of the same size align their text and icons side by side; heights from size.control.{size}.
Value typography typography.body.{size} (14, 16, 18 px): entered text is content, not a control label; md at 16 px also avoids the automatic zoom of mobile browsers on focus.

Focus shows the approved color.field.focus.border and, on every focus (text entry shows a caret whatever the modality), the same outer focus ring as Button; an invalid field keeps its invalid border while focused, the ring shows focus.
Readonly keeps the field focusable, selectable and submitted; disabled is neither focusable nor submitted.
type limited to text, email, password, search, tel, url; number is NumberInput (wave 6).
The interaction target meets 44 px in block size without enlarging the visible field (decisions.md minimum target), as Button.

Trailing actions B (user at the contract gate, 2026-10-26: "2 je partirai sur B", with the rule that sm forbids the action): trailing accepts an IconButton at sizes md and lg only. The input imposes on it an existing IconButton size one step smaller (sm in md, md in lg), intent neutral and appearance ghost, without any local override of IconButton: its tokens and behavior are unchanged, the host only chooses its options (the host-imposes-size principle of decisions.md, 2026-10-26). Block and inline-end inset (minHeight − box)/2: 4 px in standard, 2 to 6 px across densities.
openDecisions: Confirm the trailing IconButton mechanism proposed in answer to the gate question (next smaller IconButton size imposed by the input, neutral ghost, no local override, forbidden at sm). The contract approval is recorded once confirmed.
nextAction: Confirm the trailing IconButton mechanism, record the contract approval, then implement (ggb-svelte) with the rest of wave 2.
implementationNotes: Wave 2 (form foundations), branch wave/2-form-foundations, contract phase started 2026-10-26.

Svelte: the trailing snippet receives the imposed IconButton props as a parameter (size, intent, appearance, disabled), so that InputText does not import IconButton and IconButton does not read a context from InputText; both folders stay self-contained. A trailing IconButton at size sm is reported as a usage error in development.
